## Meet a scientist: Gottlieb Haberlandt

In 1902, the Austrian botanist Gottlieb Haberlandt proposed a bold idea. Any living plant cell, even a fully mature cell from a permanent tissue, can develop into a complete plant if it is given suitable nutrients and favourable conditions.

<!-- STEP -->
## Totipotency

He suggested that plant cells have the ability to form different types of cells and also to change them. This special ability of plant cells is called **totipotency**.

<!-- STEP -->
## From an idea to a technology

Haberlandt's idea laid the foundation for a new branch of biology, known as **Plant Tissue Culture Technology**.
